info.text:
Landlord sold your building? Your lease didn't end.
In most states, a fixed-term lease transfers with the building: same rent, same end date.
In California, the old owner must transfer the deposit (minus lawful deductions) or refund it; if not, the new owner can in many cases be on the hook too.
After a foreclosure, federal law (PTFA) generally lets tenants finish the lease or gives at least 90 days' notice.
Month-to-month renters have less protection, though some states and cities require just cause.
About one in three US households rents (Census, Q2 2026).
Sources: Cal. Civil Code 1950.5, Protecting Tenants at Foreclosure Act, US Census Bureau.
News and education, not financial advice.
